questions.text:
Find the center and classify the conic:
\[
4x^2+9y^2-24x+54y+36=0.
\]
A parabola has focus \((5,-1)\) and directrix \(x=-1\). Without writing the full equation first, find its vertex and the value of \(y\) when \(x=8\).
An ellipse has center \((2,1)\), passes through \((2,5)\), and has foci \((2,-2)\) and \((2,4)\). Find its equation.

A hyperbola has asymptotes
\[
y-3=\pm 2(x+1),
\]
and one vertex at \((1,3)\). Find its equation.

Determine all real values of \(k\) for which
\[
x^2-4x+y^2+2ky+4k-5=0
\]
represents exactly one point.

A conic is given by
\[
9x^2-16y^2-54x-64y+19=0.
\]
Find its center, identify the conic, and determine its asymptotes mentally by transforming it to standard form.

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q1
questions.text: An ellipse in the coordinate plane has its foci at $(3,4)$ and $(-5,12)$. If the ellipse passes through the origin, what is the length of its major axis?

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q2
questions.text: The graph of the equation $x^2 - y^2 - 4x + 6y - 5 = 0$ and the line $x = 10$ enclose a bounded region in the coordinate plane. What is the area of this region?

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q3
questions.text: A parabola has its focus at $(0, 7)$ and its directrix is the horizontal line $y = -7$. If a point $P$ on this parabola is at a distance of $25$ from the focus, what is the shortest distance from $P$ to the $x$-axis?

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text: Consider the hyperbola given by the equation $3x^2 - y^2 - 12x + 10y - 100 = 0$. What is the degree measure of the acute angle between its asymptotes?

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q5
questions.text: An ellipse has its foci at $(3,-4)$ and $(3,4)$, and it passes through the origin. What is the maximum $y$-coordinate of any point on this ellipse?

questions.source_label: Chapter 11.4 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q6
questions.text: For what real value of $k$ does the graph of the equation $x^2 + 4y^2 - 10x + 24y + k = 0$ degenerate into a single point?
